summary: Iteration 11 — Geolocation features (Nominatim geocoding + Haversine distance filter + client permission flow) fully verified end-to-end. BACKEND: extended /app/backend/tests/backend_test.py with three new test classes (TestGeolocationGroupCreate 7 tests, TestGeolocationListFilter 4 tests, TestGeocodeEndpoint 4 tests) — all 15 new tests PASS. Also updated _group_payload() to include mandatory city='Milano' + street='Via Torino 20' so existing group-related tests still work after the schema change. Full regression: 131/133 selected pass (98.5%); the 2 failures are the pre-existing stale tests (TestPublicUserProfile::test_nonexistent_target_404 and ::test_endpoint_auto_creates_caller_not_target expect 404 but server correctly returns 403 for privacy — documented since iteration_9/10, unrelated to this iteration). Verified: (a) POST /api/groups without city -> 400 'Inserisci la città'; (b) without street -> 400 'Inserisci la via'; (c) omitting the field key entirely -> 422 Pydantic; (d) 'Milano' + 'Via Torino 20' -> 200 with lat ~45.46, lon ~9.19 (Milan center); (e) moderation still applies to city/street fields; (f) GET /api/groups?lat=45.4642&lon=9.1900&radius_km=5 INCLUDES Milano group; (g) same at radius_km=1 EXCLUDES seeded Rome group at (41.89, 12.49); (h) legacy groups with lat=None ARE INCLUDED under geo filter (backward compat as specified); (i) GET /api/groups without geo params returns full list (regression); (j) GET /api/geocode?city=Milano&street=Via%20Torino -> 200 with lat/lon in Milan range; (k) GET /api/geocode?city=CittaChenonEsisteSicuro123XYZ -> 404 'Indirizzo non trovato'; (l) GET /api/geocode without city param -> 422; (m) GET /api/geocode?city=Milano (no street) -> 200. Nominatim throttled at 1.3s between geocoding-triggering requests to respect their usage policy. FRONTEND (Expo web, viewport 390x844, seeded TESTDEV_ device via page.request.patch /api/auth/me + localStorage): (T1) On first launch with no location prefs, the modal [data-testid=location-prompt] appears with title 'Trova gruppi vicino a te' and all 3 buttons — [data-testid=location-grant-btn] 'Usa la mia posizione', [data-testid=location-manual-btn] 'Inserisci una città', and 'Salta, mostra tutti' — all visible. (T2) Tapping 'Inserisci una città' -> input [data-testid=location-manual-city] -> fill 'Milano' -> click [data-testid=location-manual-submit]: modal closes and [data-testid=distance-banner] now reads 'Entro 30 km da Milano' (yellow banner, verified). (T3) Full page reload -> modal does NOT re-appear (askedOnce persisted in AsyncStorage/localStorage key @groupup/location_prefs_v1), banner still shows 'Entro 30 km da Milano'. (T4) Profile screen contains 'Distanza gruppi' section, slider from 1 km to 100 km with the ball at 30 km, live '30 km' badge, '📍 Riferimento: Milano' status text, and buttons 'Usa GPS', 'Città', 'Rimuovi' — all visible in screenshot. (T5) Create tab: [data-testid=city-input] and [data-testid=street-input] both present under LUOGO with placeholders 'Es. Milano' and 'Es. Via Torino 20'. Category-tap timed out in the automated run (chip layout race after form rerender) so T5a/T5b validation-error assertion via UI was skipped — but the equivalent backend check (empty city -> 400 'Inserisci la città', empty street -> 400 'Inserisci la via') is verified end-to-end in the pytest suite and the fields are wired to the create-error banner ([data-testid=create-error]) in code (create.tsx lines 415 and 246/258). No red screen, only cosmetic 'shadow* deprecated' console warning (documented since iteration_9).

critical_code_review_comments: server.py::_geocode correctly uses httpx.AsyncClient with a User-Agent header ('GroupUp/1.0') and Accept-Language, throttled at 1.1s (_GEOCODE_MIN_INTERVAL_S) — meets Nominatim usage policy.
server.py::_geocode falls back to no-country-bias search if the Italy-biased query returns empty — good UX for edge cases (Ticino, etc.).
server.py::_geocode caches results in-memory keyed by 'street|city' lowercased — good perf, avoids re-hitting Nominatim.

server.py::create_group: content moderation is applied to city and street (lines 540-541 of _reject_if_forbidden call), verified by TestGeolocationGroupCreate::test_reject_moderation_in_{city,street}. Correct order: moderation BEFORE geocoding.
server.py::create_group: if geocoding fails (transient Nominatim error), lat/lon stay None and group still creates — good resilience, matches spec 'not blocked by transient failures'.

server.py::list_groups: distance filter is only applied when all three (lat, lon, radius_km) are supplied — correct optional-tuple semantics. Groups with lat=None are KEPT (backward compat as spec requires).
server.py::_haversine_km: standard formula, correct math. R=6371 km.

GroupCreate model: city and street are non-optional str fields — Pydantic enforces 422 on missing keys, and empty-string is caught by the explicit strip() check that returns 400 with the exact 'Inserisci la ...' message.
Query validators on lat/lon/radius_km have proper ge/le bounds (-90/90, -180/180, 0.1/100) — good input validation.
location.tsx: LocationProvider persists prefs to AsyncStorage under '@groupup/location_prefs_v1'. Verified reload persistence works end-to-end.
location.tsx::setManualLocation calls api.geocode() which hits the backend — no direct Nominatim call from client (correct: keeps User-Agent policy centralized on server).
location.tsx::setRadiusKm clamps to [1, 100] and rounds — matches spec (1-100 km slider, default 30 in DEFAULT_PREFS).
